misconfig_patterns: Bound to 0.0.0.0 by default — no auth, no firewall = full parse surface exposed
Docker deployments commonly expose 9998 publicly without network policy
Tika 1.x still in production in RAG pipelines; versions 1.7-1.17 carry CVE-2018-1335 command injection
tika-core 1.13-3.2.1 vulnerable to CVE-2025-66516 XXE via XFA-in-PDF
-enableFileUrl flag (removed in 2.x) allowed arbitrary file:// URL reads when present in 1.x
No version endpoint — version only visible in startup log; operators unaware of running version

active_probe.false_positive_check: Response body must contain exact string 'This is Tika Server. Please PUT' — any other response body is FP

deployment_tells: GET /tika returns 'This is Tika Server. Please PUT' body — high specificity
X-Tika-OCR* and X-Tika-PDF* request headers accepted as command pass-through in 1.x
No Authorization header required on any endpoint by default
Common in Open WebUI, LangChain RAG, and Solr Tika integration deployments
Censys identified ~565 exposed instances as of December 2025
pivot_paths: CVE-2025-66516 XXE via malicious PDF (XFA payload) -> file:///etc/passwd read or SSRF -> cloud IMDS at 169.254.169.254
CVE-2018-1335 (<=1.17): PUT /meta with X-Tika-OCRTesseractPath header -> OS command execution on server
PUT /rmeta with recursive archive (quine) -> CVE-2019-10094 StackOverflow -> DoS or process crash
PUT /unpack -> extract embedded files -> enumerate document structure / exfil embedded payloads
GET /parsers/details -> full parser inventory -> identify which file types trigger dangerous code paths
vulnerabilities: CVE-2025-66516: XXE via XFA embedded in PDF; tika-core 1.13-3.2.1, tika-pdf-module 2.0.0-3.2.1, tika-parsers 1.13-1.28.5; CVSS 9.8 (NIST)/8.4 (Apache CNA); enables arbitrary file read, SSRF, conditional RCE; fixed in 3.2.2
CVE-2025-54988: predecessor advisory for same XFA/PDF XXE; superseded by CVE-2025-66516 which identified tika-core as root cause
CVE-2021-44228 (Log4Shell): Tika 2.0.0-BETA through 2.1.0 used vulnerable log4j2; JNDI lookup RCE; fixed in Tika 2.2.0
CVE-2021-44832: log4j2 JDBC Appender RCE; Tika 2.0.0-BETA through 2.2.1; lower severity (requires config modify); fixed in Tika 2.2.1
CVE-2019-10094: StackOverflow in RecursiveParserWrapper via self-referencing archive quine; Tika 1.7-1.21; CVSS 7.8 HIGH; fixed in 1.22
CVE-2018-1335: command injection via X-Tika-OCR* HTTP headers passed to TesseractOCRParser/ProcessBuilder; Tika 1.7-1.17; CVSS HIGH; fixed in 1.18
CVE-2018-1339: infinite loop in ChmParser via crafted CHM file; Tika before 1.18; CVSS 5.5 MEDIUM; fixed in 1.18
CVE-2018-1338: infinite loop in BPGParser via crafted BPG file; Tika before 1.18; CVSS 5.5 MEDIUM; fixed in 1.18
CVE-2016-6809: Java RCE via deserialization in MATLAB (.mat) parser using jmatio; Tika 1.6-1.13; CVSS 9.8 CRITICAL; fixed in 1.14
CVE-2016-4434: XXE in OOXML spreadsheet and PDF XMP metadata parsers due to improper XML parser init; Tika 0.10-1.12; CVSS 7.8 HIGH; fixed in 1.13
CVE-2022-30973: ReDoS in StandardsExtractingContentHandler; Tika before 1.28.3; CVSS 5.5 MEDIUM; only affects non-default handler; fixed in 1.28.3
corpus_corrections: 2026-06-19 verify: DROP http.headers:X-Tika-OCR (request header, 0-hit). product:'Apache Tika' weak (facet unpopulated). No /version endpoint -> version-tier dork unreliable; Shodan-dark via greeting (Shodan crawls root, not /tika). Censys ~565 baseline.
